steps.content: Hecate rarely gets to see Donald. Most of the time he's playing as an annoying Executive Officer. But she's always remembered how he acted during the riots, which makes her believe that everything about that man is just pretense.

Back then, attacked by the Mania of the shackles, Hecate almost lost her sanity. She recalls how this man single-handedly subdued the raging Nightmare and fought off over a dozen Rustfire Sinners. She still clearly remembers the words he said.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is the mission all that matters? What about your own life? Then... What about her?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is that Chief someone really important to you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then I'll go bring him back.
steps.female_content: Then I'll go bring her back.

steps.content: Whether he's an Executive Officer or a Rustfire member, whether he's a Sinner or not, this man saved Hella when Hecate couldn't, and even promised to rescue ${PlayerName}, whom Hecate failed to protect. It was he who brought back Raven and many more people.

Donald is powerful. If someone could break through the Black Ring of Rustfire and bring Chief back, it could only be him. Hecate is convinced of this, just like she believes that ${PlayerName} will definitely come back. She has no choice but to believe it.
But she doesn't want to keep waiting anymore.
[Scene change] Syndicate street in flames
Donald walks in the middle of the avenue, dressed in the uniform of an Executive Officer. Hecate follows two blocks behind with Nightmare slightly ahead of her. She tails him covertly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...He's heading toward BR-002. There are no refugees there, only the FAC anti-Mania frontline and gangs stealing crystals of Mania contamination... Maybe even the Underground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He's stopped to observe something... Or is he waiting for someone?
Several gangster-like Syndicans come out of the street corner and surround Donald. Donald stops in his tracks and converses with them calmly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are those his companions? Informants? Are they Rustfire or gangsters, or other undercover agents?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What are they talking about? Information? Does it have anything to do with Chief?

She can't hear their conversation from this distance, and Nightmare can't get any closer. Hecate can't be sure if there are any Sinners among these people. She's extremely tense and agitated. The contaminated shackles begin to emerge on her body again.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I must get a little closer... I can't let any possibility slip by...

steps.speaker: Raging Gangster
steps.content: Go to hell, you ******* Executive Officer!
Shouting, those people pick up their weapons and swing them at Donald. Hecate stops in her tracks.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Are they enemies?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Judging from their fighting style, the enemies are not Sinners, but they are using Mania weapons... It's fine. He is strong. He doesn't need my help, that might reveal me... and...
She wants to see that man fight again. She's eager to witness the technique of a truly powerful fighter.
A steel pipe is thrown at Donald, and with a twist of his body, it misses and lands on the ground. He goes on to dodge the subsequent attacks.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He dodged them. His reflexes are impressive.
Meanwhile, another person hits Donald's butt hard from behind with a road sign. Donald only hops a small step forward, moves to a higher vantage point, and turns to look at his attacker.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He withstood this attack... Amazing defense. Is he an Endura Sinner? Is he going to strike back with his power?
Looking back, Hecate has never seen Donald use his power. Perhaps he doesn't need to use his power to deal with these people?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I've become too reliant on my abilities. If my shackles are contaminated, I can't do anything without Nightmare.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm useless when Chief needs me the most. Even Hella is suffering because of me...
Luckily, Donald's fight distracts her from her self-blaming.

He starts to move, charging at the gangsters. An enemy attacks his head, but he dodges. Hecate watches intently. He's so agile. He seizes the chance to aim for the gangster's lower body, grabbing his legs to subdue him, then he...
...Wait a minute, why does this pose seem familiar?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Please... spare... me...!!
Donald's cry echoes throughout the street like a bell, shaking Hecate's heart. She finally remembers the shocking scene she witnessed when she first came to Syndicate.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief...!!!
Confusion gradually replaces her anxiety. Hecate stares stiffly at this farce, standing still for a long time. Eventually, amid different variations of Donald's cry, she sighs.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella... Is this a Syndican tradition?
